name: FCX/NEM Pair Trade — Z-Score Mean Reversion
description: Long FCX / short NEM pairs strategy. Entry when the FCX/NEM price ratio 252-day rolling z-score crosses below -2.0 (ratio is historically cheap). Exit after 63 trading days (time stop via barssince) or if the ratio drops -15% from entry level (ratio stop loss). Each leg sized at 50% of equity. Re-entry allowed on any new z-score crossunder signal.
source:
# FCX/NEM Pair Trade — Z-Score Mean Reversion
#
# THESIS: Long FCX / Short NEM when the FCX/NEM price ratio is historically
# cheap (z-score < -2.0). The ratio mean-reverts over a 63-bar horizon.
#
# ENTRY:  crossunder of 252-day rolling z-score of FCX/NEM ratio below -2.0
# EXIT 1: 63 trading days elapsed since entry (time stop via barssince)
# EXIT 2: FCX/NEM ratio drops -15% from entry ratio level (ratio stop loss)
# SIZING: 50% of equity per leg (FCX long, NEM short)
#
# ARCHITECTURE:
#   Both FCX and NEM are in assets[]. Each asset context loads the other
#   as a reference stock to compute the same FCX/NEM ratio.
#   FCX context → long_and_short_zone with long_entry only
#   NEM context → long_and_short_zone with short_entry only

# --- Data ---
# Primary asset (FCX in FCX-context, NEM in NEM-context)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# Reference leg (the other stock in the pair)
# In FCX context: nem_ref.c = NEM close
# In NEM context: fcx_ref.c = FCX close
nem_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
fcx_ref = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()

# --- Ratio Construction ---
# FCX/NEM ratio — same formula in both contexts:
#   FCX context: close / nem_ref.c  = FCX / NEM  ✓
#   NEM context: fcx_ref.c / close  = FCX / NEM  ✓
# We need the same ratio in both contexts so signals are synchronized.
fcx_close = close if is_asset_ref(ticker='FCX') else fcx_ref.c
nem_close = close if is_asset_ref(ticker='NEM') else nem_ref.c

ratio = fcx_close / nem_close

# --- Signal: 252-day rolling z-score of the ratio ---
ratio_zscore = zscore(window=252)(ratio)

# Entry pulse: z-score crosses below -2.0 (ratio is cheap → long FCX / short NEM)
entry_pulse = crossunder(ratio_zscore, -2.0)

# --- State Management ---
# Capture the ratio value at the moment of entry (for ratio stop loss)
entry_ratio = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(entry_pulse, ratio)

# Ratio stop loss: current ratio has dropped -15% from entry ratio
# (ratio fell further → spread widened against us → cut the trade)
ratio_stop_hit = is_valid(entry_ratio) and (ratio < entry_ratio * 0.85)

# Time exit: 63 trading days elapsed since entry pulse
bars_elapsed = coalesce(barssince()(entry_pulse), 9999)
time_exit = bars_elapsed >= 63

# Combined exit condition
exit_signal = time_exit or ratio_stop_hit

# Hold state: enter on pulse, exit on time or ratio stop
held = hold_until()(enter=entry_pulse, exit=exit_signal)

# --- Execution ---
# FCX context: go LONG (ratio is cheap → buy FCX)
# NEM context: go SHORT (ratio is cheap → sell NEM)
# Use is_asset_ref to wire the correct direction per context.
is_fcx = is_asset_ref(ticker='FCX')
is_nem = is_asset_ref(ticker='NEM')

long_and_short_zone()(
    long_entry=held and is_fcx,
    short_entry=held and is_nem
)

# 50% of equity per leg
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)

# --- Event Markers ---
# Mark entry events (z-score crossunder below -2.0)
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Pair Entry',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX/NEM Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='NEM Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio_zscore, ratio, fcx_close, nem_close, entry_pulse)

# Mark ratio stop-loss exits
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Ratio Stop Hit',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Entry Ratio', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio Drawdown', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ratio, entry_ratio, (ratio - entry_ratio) / entry_ratio, ratio_stop_hit and held)
